guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0046 to 0.1498 (z=+631) and latency-50 from 0.003 to 0.0369, the largest deviations in the digest, while its CPU, memory and socket metrics show no resource exhaustion. checkoutservice logs 138 'failed to send order confirmation ... no healthy upstream' errors (emailservice is its callee), and emailservice logs show health-check AttributeErrors, so checkout errors originate downstream at emailservice.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for injected network latency or a bad deploy (the gRPC health Check handler is missing), restart or roll back the emailservice pod to restore healthy upstream status, and verify latency returns to baseline.
